Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

#include<vector>
#include<algorithm>
#include<iostream>
using namespace std;

class Solution {
public:
    int minSteps(int n) {
        vector<int> dp(n + 1, INT_MAX); // dp[i]: 得到i个A的最少操作次数
        dp[1] = 0;
        for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++)
        {
            for (int j = 2; j <= i; j++)
            {
                if (i % j != 0) continue;
                int k = i / j;
                dp[i] = min(dp[i], dp[k] + 1 + (j - 1));
                break; /* 用贪心思想优化 */
            }          
        }
        return dp[n];
    }
};

// Test
int main()
{
    Solution sol;
    int n = 10000;
    auto res = sol.minSteps(n);
    cout << res << endl;

    return 0;
}
